objective: One change covering #26 and #28 (they share prompt v2). (A) #26: the tutor lists every evaluation it quotes in a new structured field on the MODEL-FACING reply, `evals: [{ side: "white"|"black", cp: integer|null, mate: integer|null }]` (exactly one of cp/mate non-null; values are from that side's point of view, positive = good for that side). Code checks each entry exactly against the engine scores in this turn's evidence (tool results or key-moment data) for that side, and the claims check rejects any evaluation-like number in `message` or `reveal` that no entry backs. The prose word rules for evaluations from #26 rounds 1-3 are NOT brought over. Round 1's move-check fixes ARE brought over from origin/issue-26-factcheck-wip commit 3df6a35 (move-number history ply, side-named mover, the 'a move or evaluation' correction text); port only those parts. (B) #28: write prompts/tutor-system.v2.md (copy v1, then change it) that (1) tells the tutor to list every quoted evaluation in `evals` and to quote none it didn't list, and (2) cuts give-aways: no naming the answer move or its piece-plus-target, no arrow that starts on the answer's from-square or ends on its to-square, no 'can your <piece> give a check?' style hints. Add a CHANGELOG entry. Extend the claims check (FR-8) to also reject the two patterns that get past it today: an arrow whose `from` is the answer move's from-square, and a message naming the answer move's piece together with the check it gives (e.g. answer Qb5+ and message 'can your queen give a check?'). Point every v1 default (evals/src/config.ts DEFAULT_PROMPT, evals/README.md, packages/tutor/test/prompt.test.ts) at v2; keep v1 on disk unchanged. Do not run live evals: the coordinator runs them after your return.
